title: The coord hook posts no intent for a claim run as backlog.py --root X claim ID or behind a wrapper such as timeout
goal: coord_hook.claimed_item finds the claim in `python3 _tools/backlog.py --root X claim ID` (a global option before the subcommand), `timeout 60 python3 _tools/backlog.py claim ID` and the same claim inside a brace group; the text forms (a commit message, an echo, a heredoc, a grep pattern) still post nothing. Found by the SP-fp3hxl6q review (S3, BG-iagias5y).

run:
import importlib.util as u,sys
s=u.spec_from_file_location('h','.claude/hooks/coord_hook.py');h=u.module_from_spec(s);s.loader.exec_module(h)
forms=['python3 _tools/backlog.py --root X claim BG-abcd1234','timeout 60 python3 _tools/backlog.py claim BG-abcd1234','{ python3 _tools/backlog.py claim BG-abcd1234; }']
got=[h.claimed_item(f) for f in forms];text=h.claimed_item('git commit -m "backlog.py claim BG-abcd1234"')
print(got,text);sys.exit(0 if got==['BG-abcd1234']*3 and text is None else 1)

import importlib.util as u,sys
s=u.spec_from_file_location('h','.claude/hooks/coord_hook.py');h=u.module_from_spec(s);s.loader.exec_module(h)
n=chr(10)
texts=['git commit -m "backlog.py claim BG-abcd1234"','echo python3 _tools/backlog.py claim BG-abcd1234','cat <<EOF'+n+'python3 _tools/backlog.py claim BG-abcd1234'+n+'EOF','grep "backlog.py claim BG-abcd1234" notes.txt','git commit -m "run timeout 60 python3 _tools/backlog.py claim BG-abcd1234"']
got=[h.claimed_item(t) for t in texts];print(got);sys.exit(0 if all(g is None for g in got) else 1)
